verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a government filing platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only describes a web portal (dashboards, online filing, FranceConnect+ login) and a guidance app (Start INPI), with no first-party command-line tool. The keyless recherche-entreprises API probe concerns a separate state data service, not a Guichet unique CLI, so it earns no credit.
